Specialized Portfolio

Mature Brands

Cannabis & Regulated Industry Work

A significant portion of my portfolio is packaging and branding work for the cannabis industry. It is some of the most technically demanding, visually complex work I have produced — strict compliance requirements, detailed dielines, and competitive retail shelves that demand standout design.

If that is not relevant to your project, no problem — the rest of the portfolio covers logos, apparel, promotional products, and illustration. If it is relevant, you will find work here that speaks for itself.

About

Two Decades.
No Shortcuts.

I founded Elevated Design on a single principle: every project deserves the same level of craft, whether it's a startup's first logo or a national brand's packaging refresh.

With over 20 years of professional design experience, I've built a reputation for delivering production-ready work — files built to spec the first time — clear, communicative, and ready for production.

From initial concept sketches to technical dielines and factory correspondence, I handle the full creative-to-production pipeline. Working with clients nationwide.
